files_summary.email_accounts.json: Email accounts: address -> {name, password}. 20 accounts across QC, procurement, manufacturing, suppliers, logistics, automated systems.
files_summary.mailboxes.json: Per-account folders (INBOX/Sent/Drafts/Trash/Archive) of threaded message dicts (id,from,to,subject,body,date,folder; optional cc,in_reply_to,thread_id,attachments). ~14 multi-message threads covering lot defects, supplier delays, calibration, audits, capex.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_mailboxes
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of folder names available in the specified user’s mailbox. Refuses requests when the user email address is missing, empty, or does not correspond to an existing mailbox. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to view that user’s mailbox.

tool_schemas.name: get_emails
tool_schemas.description: Returns all messages contained in the specified folder for the given user, defaulting to INBOX when no folder is provided. Refuses requests when the user email address is missing, empty, or the mailbox does not exist, or when the named folder is not present in that mailbox. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to read that user’s mail.

folder.description: Folder name, e.g. INBOX or Sent.

tool_schemas.name: find_emails
tool_schemas.description: Searches a user’s mailbox messages and returns those whose From and/or Subject contains the provided substring filters. Refuses requests when the user email address is missing, empty, or the mailbox does not exist, and refuses searches that provide neither a sender nor a subject filter. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to search that user’s mail.

tool_schemas.name: send_email
tool_schemas.description: Sends an email from the specified sender account to a recipient and returns the created message details as recorded by PostHaven Mailbox Manager. Refuses requests when any required field (from_user, to, subject, body) is missing or empty, when content_type is provided but is not a supported value, or when the from_user mailbox does not exist. Refuses sending when the caller is not permitted to send as the from_user.

tool_schemas.name: clear_folder
tool_schemas.description: Deletes all messages from the specified folder in the user’s mailbox (INBOX by default) and returns a confirmation of what was cleared. Refuses requests when the user email address is missing, empty, or the mailbox does not exist, or when the named folder does not exist in that mailbox. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to modify that user’s mail.

metadata.name: PostHaven Mailbox Manager
metadata.description: A hosted mailbox service that lets users manage email accounts by listing folders, retrieving and searching messages, sending new mail, and clearing folder contents via API.
